findings.message: PolishFirstLanguagePolicyService is fully implemented. Kid profile locale is forced to pl-PL, while parent non-Polish locale is allowed only when ParentalControlPolicy.language_override_allowed is true.

Polish-first policy integrated into AI text prompt wrappers in request_ai_creation_help_service.gd and request_gameplay_hint_service.gd. Both services resolve locale via PolishFirstLanguagePolicyService with fallback to localization policy.

Voice governance now wired to parental language policy controls in audio_governance_service.gd. Added optional dependencies for ParentalPolicyStorePort and PolishFirstLanguagePolicyService. Voice locale resolution uses policy service with kid forced Polish and parent override-controlled.

Backward compatibility maintained in audio_governance_service.gd via _is_parent_override_enabled() which checks actor.preferences as fallback. Metadata language stays Polish by default and only switches for parent when policy override is enabled.
ElevenLabs TTS adapter now includes explicit override metadata. get_last_request_metadata() payload includes allow_language_override flag for proper policy enforcement.

Contract tests expanded for voice override behavior in audio_governance_service_contract_test.gd. New checks verify parent with policy override can use non-Polish voice locale while kid remains Polish even when parent override exists.

Focused TASK-032 contract runner created (run_task_032_tests.gd) covering PolishFirstLanguagePolicyService, RequestGameplayHintService, RequestAICreationHelpService, and AudioGovernanceService. All tests pass: Tests: 4  Checks: 45  Failed tests: 0.
Contracts documentation updated in tests/contracts/README.md to reflect new language policy integration.
